title: MinSR Scales Deep Neural Quantum States Past Tensor-Network DMRG on 2D Magnets
aiSystem: MinSR (Minimum-Step Stochastic Reconfiguration + Deep ResNet NQS)
whyItMatters: Broke the optimization ceiling of neural quantum states—scaling past 100,000 parameters—and outperformed tensor-network DMRG on benchmark 2D frustrated quantum magnets and spin liquids.
summary: Ao Chen and Markus Heyl (University of Augsburg) solved a seven-year bottleneck in neural quantum states (since Carleo & Troyer 2017) in Nature Physics (2024). Standard Stochastic Reconfiguration required inverting an N_p × N_p Fisher matrix, capping neural wavefunctions to ~10⁴ parameters; Chen & Heyl’s Minimum-Step Stochastic Reconfiguration (MinSR) reformulated the update into sample space (scaling with Monte Carlo samples rather than parameter count), unlocking >100,000-parameter deep ResNet wavefunctions that surpassed state-of-the-art tensor-network DMRG and variational Monte Carlo on the frustrated 2D J₁–J₂ Heisenberg model and uncovered clear signatures of a quantum spin liquid.
technicalHighlights: Eliminated the O(N_p³) Fisher-matrix inversion bottleneck, scaling deep neural quantum state optimization smoothly to >10⁵–10⁶ parameters.
Surpassed leading tensor-network (DMRG) and variational Monte Carlo ground-state energies on the notoriously hard 2D frustrated J₁–J₂ Heisenberg magnet.
Provided high-accuracy evidence supporting a quantum spin-liquid phase in the maximally frustrated regime around J₂/J₁ = 0.5.
caveats: Variational Monte Carlo sampling noise and sign-structure learning remain challenging for very large lattices (>16×16) and fermionic Hubbard models at arbitrary doping.

scoreRationale.foundational: Unlocked deep-learning scaling laws for variational quantum many-body wavefunctions, surpassing classical DMRG in 2D frustrated magnets.
scoreRationale.ripple: Adopted rapidly across quantum condensed matter, Rydberg simulators, and neural fermionic wavefunction research.
scoreRationale.verification: Peer-reviewed in Nature Physics with strict variational energy upper-bound benchmarks beating DMRG and open code.
scoreRationale.velocity: Collapsed the cubic parameter-scaling wall that had limited neural quantum states since 2017.

sources.label: Nature Physics (2024): Empowering deep neural quantum states through efficient optimization
